sources.计时真源: /tmp/test-timing-raw.txt（398 个 TAP subtest，Σ单测 765,879.8ms，harness 自报 wall 293,688.9ms）

law: 2026-08-03 陛下定谳四条：①≤100s 常规预算（背景）②最小必要成本＝唯一判准 ③闸类负向案不可删 ④测试也是复杂度

projectedSeconds.basis: Σ 单测耗时口径（可直接由 /tmp/test-timing-raw.txt 逐条加总复核）

wallFrame.assumption: 并行度不变（0.383 wall/Σ），且共享冷装夹具全程串行不可并行——两条都往悲观取。

assumptions: delete → 0（16 条合计仅 70ms，对预算无意义，价值在复杂度不在秒数）。
merge → 被并方 ≥1s 的按保留 20% 计残值（并入方要多跑一点），<1s 的按 0 计。
rebuild → ≥1s 的按保留 10% 计（各卷实测成本校准是 30–800× 价差，10% 是刻意悲观），<1s 的按保留 50% 计。
凡审卷自报的 after/saving 估计高于上面模型的，取审卷的（就高不就低）。group-10 取其自报 11.6s、group-13 取 6.5s、collector-receipt 取 0.35s。
另计一次性共享冷装/pack 夹具 55s（单次实测 48.7s + 装机余量）。这笔是全套只付一次的固定成本，也是剩余预算缺口的全部来源。
陛下所述「全套现状 ~1060s」与本次 TAP 捕获对不上（Σ=765.9s / wall=293.7s）。本合账一律以可复核的 TAP 数据为准；若 1060s 口径成立，按同比例落到 ~1060×(190.1/765.9)≈263s。

fact-fee56a0fa788.preFixRedCounterexample: Red (rebuild class): test/pi-test-harness.test.ts :: "isolated packs leave shared dist identity stable under concurrent contract imports" measured 63643.217917 ms with non-minimal construction. Each one (helpers/pi-test-harness.ts:115-141) mkdtemps a root, runs materializePackageTree() which copies the ENTIRE live node_modules tree (helpers:79-85 `cp -r node_modules`), then runs a real `npm pack` whose prepack fires the full TypeScript build. That is the most expensive operation in the suite, multiplied by three. The other scaffolding — 24 in-loop import rounds + 8 trailing rounds (:160,:196) and a sha256-of-every-file snapshot of the whole dist tree (:85-98) — is cheap but proves nothing extra: repetition cannot prove the absence of a race, while the structural fact forecloses it

Better still, take the pack from the suite-wide shared cold-pack fixture (see sharedFixtureOpportunities) so this test pays ~0 for materialization. Estimated 63.6s -> ~0.1s shared / ~21s standalone. fact-3a29dc2a5cd9.behavior: Path-confinement gate: a bundle entry whose clone path escapes the workspace (traversal / absolute / colliding) or whose parent directory is a symlink must be rejected, so a reviewer bundle can never write outside the reviewed clone.
fact-3a29dc2a5cd9.preFixRedCounterexample: Red (rebuild class): test/reviewer-bundle-materializer.test.ts :: "materializer rejects traversal, absolute paths, collisions, and symlink parents" measured 5.9605 ms with non-minimal construction. Expensive construction costing 5.96 ms under the frozen timing run. FALSE GREEN, confirmed by execution. The three traversal cases at test:12 mutate relativeClonePath on an already-compiled bundle, but manifestBytes (src/reviewer-construction.ts:54-56) destructures away only `bytes` and therefore covers relativeClonePath — so the mutation breaks the manifest digest and all three cases die at src/reviewer-bundle-materializer.ts:16, never reaching the confinement guard at lines 22-24.
